data.name: Divisha
data.gender_notes: Divisha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Divisha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘divya’, meaning divine, celestial, or divine inspiration. The name is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom. Divisha signifies a strong desire, wish, or ambition, driven by the divine inspiration within. The name Divisha carries the meaning “Desire, Wish, Ambition” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Divisha usually hope their child will grow to embody desire, wish, ambition and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the divine, fueled by inner wisdom and ambition.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Divisha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
